subject: How to order the horizontal axis

messages.author: 18e4254e2eb223ba
messages.subject: How to order the horizontal axis
parts:
I have been having problems with ggplot2 reordering the axis when
plotting data. (taking a list and organizing in ascending numeric or
alphabetized, rather than in the order given)
for example

df <- data.frame(
count= c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
name = c("apples", "oranges", "peaches", "pears", "octopus")
)

ggplot(df, aes(x=name, y=count)) + geom_bar()

produces a plot where octopus comes after apples, instead of after
pears.

I know this is a bit of a newbie question, but help is appreciated all
the same.


Thanks in advance,
Sam

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: How to order the horizontal axis
parts:
Sam,
convert names to an ordered factor

> df <- data.frame(
>        count= c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
>        name = c("apples", "oranges", "peaches", "pears", "octopus")
>        )

> df <- data.frame(
>        count= c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
>        name = c("apples", "oranges", "peaches", "pears", "octopus")
>        )
>
> ggplot(df, aes(x=name, y=count)) + geom_bar()
